documents.title: Chelmsford Council Working-age Council Tax Reduction Scheme (operative 2026/27)
Chelmsford Council — Full Council adoption record for the 2026/27 Council Tax Reduction Scheme (2026/27 budget/Council Tax meeting)

identification.carries_amendments: retains the 2025/26 scheme as the 2026/27 scheme with no changes
identification.chain:
"7.2 Local Council Tax Support Scheme
The Council was required to approve a Local Council Tax Support Scheme for 2026/27. The Cabinet on 11 November 2025 had recommended that the 2025-26 scheme be retained in its current form.
RESOLVED that the Local Council Tax Support Scheme for 2025-26 be retained and adopted as the Scheme for 2026-27."
(Full Council minutes, 3 December 2025, item 7.2)

Underlying Cabinet recommendation (11 November 2025 report, "LOCAL COUNCIL TAX SUPPORT (LCTS) SCHEME 2026/27"): "That Cabinet recommend Council re-adopt the current LCTS scheme without amendment for 2026-27." Option chosen was explicitly "1. The 2025/26 LCTS scheme is adopted without amendment for 2026/2027" (rejecting options to make it more or less generous), with the report's conclusion stating: "With a foreseeable need to design a new LCTS scheme for the new unitary in 2028-29, now is not the time to be making changes to Chelmsford City Council's current scheme. Cabinet should therefore recommend that Council re-adopt the current scheme, which has remained unchanged for over ten years, for 2026-27."
